## ABOUT US

Running a business comes with a lot to manage. We’re here to make it easier.

Whether it’s helping your team look their best, keeping your facility clean and safe, or staying
ready for whatever the day brings, Cintas supports businesses of every size across workwear,
facilities, first aid & safety, fire protection, and beyond.

With dependable service and operational excellence, we help you solve problems before they slow you
down.

Together, we create better, safer, more professional workdays.

[Learn More][159]

## Investor Information

### Cintas Announces Fiscal 2026 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Results

Cintas reported results for its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter ended May 31, 2026. Revenue for the
fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 was $2.91 billion compared to $2.67 billion in last year’s fourth
quarter, an increase of 8.9%.
[ read more ][160]

### Cintas Announces Webcast for Fiscal 2026 Fourth Quarter Results

Cintas will conduct a conference call to address the financial results beginning at 10:00 a.m., EST,
on Wednesday, July 15, 2026.

Running a business comes with a lot to manage. We’re here to make it easier.

Whether it’s helping your team look their best, keeping your facility clean and safe, or staying
ready for whatever the day brings, Cintas supports businesses of every size across workwear,
facilities, first aid & safety, fire protection, and beyond.

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This

corporate social responsibility program.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

### [ Pharmaceutical & Medical Supplies Distribution Services ][127]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

### [ Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions ][129]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at
a computer.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Staples range of [health & wellness products][129] can enhance your workspace and overall
well-being. Shop ergonomic furniture & tech options, as well as smart watches, candles, essential
oils & more. Our curved whiteboard has an ergonomically crafted shape to prevent strain. And a new
selection of [guided journals][130] are available, with topics including anxiety & productivity.


[Take advantage of Staples EasyRewards and AutoRestock and check another thing off your list for
good.]

### Perks of Shopping Staples

We pride ourselves on making shopping a breeze. With [Staples Easy Rewards][131], you can earn
rewards on every purchase, plus extra rewards on your chosen bonus categories. Our
[AutoRestock][132] feature ensures you never run out of essential supplies, with easy-to-manage
subscriptions. Whether you prefer to shop in-store or online, we offer flexible options for
shipping, same-day delivery, or in-store pickup.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

## Welcome to Attindas Hygiene Partners!

We are a leading global personal care products company with unique adult incontinence, baby care,
and clinical products.  Whether for our brands, or for our partners’ brands, we work every day to
make absorbent hygiene affordable, effective, and widely available.

[Learn More ][79]

## Trusted brands available where you need us

Our brand portfolio touches the lives of babies that are just starting out and makes living the
‘golden years’ more comfortable and worry-free.  You’ll find them in retailers, pharmacies, nursing
homes, hospitals, and on-line throughout the world!

[Learn more][80]

## Innovating for health, dignity, and comfort

We are experts in understanding the real needs of our users, caregivers, customers, and healthcare
professionals.  And we never stop innovating our products from those insights with new and modern
technology.

[Learn more][81]

## Making it Personal is what we do

At Attindas, we work in Personal Care, but it’s not just how we describe our business, it’s more
than that…. it’s who we are…It’s Personal...and it shapes how work internally and how we show up
with customers and our consumers.

[Learn more][82]

## Attincare: Our latest digital innovation!

Internet-based and easy-to-use, Attincare is our new tool helping nursing homes save valuable time. 
Organization, planning, and cost control have never been so easy or effective!

[Contact Us ][83]

Careers at Attindas

# Make a living, make a difference!

Our rewarding positions provide opportunities to contribute and grow from day one and for an entire
career.

[Join Us!][84]

Attindas and Our World

# Caring for people, communities, and planet

Our products care for people every day, and our work to reduce our footprint and nurture our
communities are at our core.

[Learn more][85]

## Welcome to Attindas Hygiene Partners!

We are a leading global personal care products company with unique adult incontinence, baby care,
and clinical products.  Whether for our brands, or for our partners’ brands, we work every day to
make absorbent hygiene affordable, effective, and widely available.

[Learn More ][79]

## Trusted brands available where you need us

Our brand portfolio touches the lives of babies that are just starting out and makes living the
‘golden years’ more comfortable and worry-free.  You’ll find them in retailers, pharmacies, nursing
homes, hospitals, and on-line throughout the world!

[Learn more][80]

## Innovating for health, dignity, and comfort

We are experts in understanding the real needs of our users, caregivers, customers, and healthcare
professionals.  And we never stop innovating our products from those insights with new and modern
technology.

[Learn more][81]

## Making it Personal is what we do

At Attindas, we work in Personal Care, but it’s not just how we describe our business, it’s more
than that…. it’s who we are…It’s Personal...and it shapes how work internally and how we show up
with customers and our consumers.

[Learn more][82]

## Attincare: Our latest digital innovation!

Internet-based and easy-to-use, Attincare is our new tool helping nursing homes save valuable time. 
Organization, planning, and cost control have never been so easy or effective!

# Elevate Hygiene With Smart Monitoring and Easy Maintenance

**High-Capacity Centralized Sanitizer System**

**Smart Monitoring for Temperature and PPE**

**Easy Maintenance With Effortless Refills**

#### Our Patent#11,000,712B1

**Centralized Hand Sanitizer System**

[Ax Virus]
[Ax Virus]

#### Learn About Who We Are

**Robert Chen, Co-Inventor**



For the past 38 + years, Mr. Chen has headed up Fortune 500 Companies in Sales and Management for
Motorola (Greater China), Compaq Computer, Symantec, FIC, and Digital Equipment Corporation.



**Highlighting Key Accomplishments**


* As GM for DEC/Compaq Computer (Taiwan), Mr. Chen won 9 out of 10 Semiconductor FAB Automation
  projects with clients like TSMC, Winbond & UMC. The revenue for 9 projects exceeded USD $150.0
  million.
* Won a major SI contract for Off-Track Betting for HK Jockey Club (HKJC). The Hong Kong Jockey Club
  is a world-class racing club that acts continuously for the betterment of Hong Kong society. A
  leader in horse racing and responsible sports wagering, and one of the world’s top ten charity
  donors. 
* As VP of Sales for First International Computer (FIC), Mr. Chen closed over USD 400.0 million in
  orders with DELL, Compaq and HP for Notebooks and Desktop Computers.



**US Patents**



Over the past seven years, Mr. Chen has filed eight (8) Patents with the US Patent and Trademark
Office (USPTO). As of May 11, 2021, USPTO approved and granted Mr. Chen six (6) patents.

[Robert Chen]
[Tiffany Chen]

**Tiffany Chen, Co-Inventor**



Tiffany Chen is a 2nd-year Medical Student at the David Geffen School of Medicine at UCLA. Tiffany
majored in Molecular, Cellular, and Developmental Biology, and minored in Biomedical Research at
UCLA. Her interests lie in the use of biotechnology, such as medical devices and brain-computer
interfaces (BCIs), to include those with neurological and cognitive disorders. She founded
[http://www.handucla.org][19] (High-tech And Neuro-Disorders) at UCLA to bridge healthcare and
technology in order to connect students with medical and industry professionals and spark innovation
and collaboration within the community.



From promoting mental wellness to treating movement disorders, biotechnology combines hands-on
patient care with cutting-edge research, which Tiffany hopes to expand upon on campus by bringing
together students of all majors, ranging from engineering to business economics. As co-inventor of
iStopShaking®, Tiffany is leading a student team as part of HAND to begin developing the three IoT
devices to treat patients with Parkinson’s disease, with the devices using miniaturized gyroscopes
to stabilize essential tremors.



Additionally, Tiffany enjoys golfing, advocating for public health, and performing research in a
neuroscience lab.

**Amelia Chen, Co-Inventor**



Amelia Chen is a Sophomore at UC Santa Barbara. She is involved in S.T.E.M. through her school club,
S.T.E.M. in Action, where she leads science webinars for middle schoolers.



She was the S.T.E.A.M. Site Director at Legarza Camp in the summer of 2022. There, she instructed
kids on the fundamentals of electricity, magnetism, gravity, and other scientific ideas at a level
they could conceptualize through building science projects.



Additionally, she is an AP Scholar and the winner of the state-wide California Stock Market
Simulation.



Amelia has taken The Psychology of Competition and Introduction to Neuroscience at Harvard
Pre-College.



She enjoys singing and dancing, and she founded the club Performing Arts Outreach, which hosts
variety shows for senior centers and elementary schools.

[Amelia Chen]

#### Learn About Who We Are

**Robert Chen, Co-Inventor**



For the past 38 + years, Mr. Chen has headed up Fortune 500 Companies in Sales and Management for
Motorola (Greater China), Compaq Computer, Symantec, FIC, and Digital Equipment Corporation.



**Highlighting Key Accomplishments**


* As GM for DEC/Compaq Computer (Taiwan), Mr. Chen won 9 out of 10 Semiconductor FAB Automation
  projects with clients like TSMC, Winbond & UMC. The revenue for 9 projects exceeded USD $150.0
  million.
* Won a major SI contract for Off-Track Betting for HK Jockey Club (HKJC). The Hong Kong Jockey Club
  is a world-class racing club that acts continuously for the betterment of Hong Kong society. A
  leader in horse racing and responsible sports wagering, and one of the world’s top ten charity
  donors. 
* As VP of Sales for First International Computer (FIC), Mr. Chen closed over USD 400.0 million in
  orders with DELL, Compaq and HP for Notebooks and Desktop Computers.



**US Patents**



Over the past seven years, Mr. Chen has filed eight (8) Patents with the US Patent and Trademark
Office (USPTO). As of May 11, 2021, USPTO approved and granted Mr. Chen six (6) patents.

[Robert Chen]
[Tiffany Chen]

**Tiffany Chen, Co-Inventor**



Tiffany Chen is a 2nd-year Medical Student at the David Geffen School of Medicine at UCLA. Tiffany
majored in Molecular, Cellular, and Developmental Biology, and minored in Biomedical Research at
UCLA. Her interests lie in the use of biotechnology, such as medical devices and brain-computer
interfaces (BCIs), to include those with neurological and cognitive disorders. She founded
[http://www.handucla.org][19] (High-tech And Neuro-Disorders) at UCLA to bridge healthcare and
technology in order to connect students with medical and industry professionals and spark innovation
and collaboration within the community.



From promoting mental wellness to treating movement disorders, biotechnology combines hands-on
patient care with cutting-edge research, which Tiffany hopes to expand upon on campus by bringing
together students of all majors, ranging from engineering to business economics. As co-inventor of
iStopShaking®, Tiffany is leading a student team as part of HAND to begin developing the three IoT
devices to treat patients with Parkinson’s disease, with the devices using miniaturized gyroscopes
to stabilize essential tremors.



Additionally, Tiffany enjoys golfing, advocating for public health, and performing research in a
neuroscience lab.

**Amelia Chen, Co-Inventor**



Amelia Chen is a Sophomore at UC Santa Barbara. She is involved in S.T.E.M. through her school club,
S.T.E.M. in Action, where she leads science webinars for middle schoolers.



She was the S.T.E.A.M. Site Director at Legarza Camp in the summer of 2022. There, she instructed
kids on the fundamentals of electricity, magnetism, gravity, and other scientific ideas at a level
they could conceptualize through building science projects.



Additionally, she is an AP Scholar and the winner of the state-wide California Stock Market
Simulation.



Amelia has taken The Psychology of Competition and Introduction to Neuroscience at Harvard
Pre-College.



She enjoys singing and dancing, and she founded the club Performing Arts Outreach, which hosts
variety shows for senior centers and elementary schools.

Our speed to market is unmatched in personal care.

## Why choose Bio Atoms as your business partner ?

Welcome to Bio Atoms, where a legacy of over **35+ years in pharmaceutical manufacturing** and **12+
years in cosmetic manufacturing** converges with a commitment to quality, reliability, and
innovation. As your trusted business partner, we pride ourselves on delivering products that not
only meet but exceed industry standards. Our extensive experience, coupled with rigorous quality
control processes and cutting-edge technology, ensures that Bio Atoms remains synonymous with
excellence. We understand the importance of reliability in your operations, and our track record of
on-time deliveries is a testament to our steadfast commitment.

.

## Our Cosmetic Manufacturing Products Process

Our cosmetic manufacturing products process includes several phases, including the conception of a
new product idea (Understanding Requirements), formulation, manufacturing, and packaging. In the
formulation phase, the scientists develop the top-quality ingredients to be used in the final
product. During manufacturing, they carefully follow procedures to ensure that the product is
consistent and meets the desired specifications. Packaging also plays an essential role in the final
product, as it must be functional, aesthetically pleasing, and brand appropriate.

.

At BioAtoms, we understand that success in the cosmetic industry is not just about creating
attractive products but also about building lasting relationships with our business partners. We
believe in empowering our partners to launch their quality brands, and we are dedicated to providing
the support and guidance needed to make their private label products a success.

### Physical Plant

We manufacture in over 23,000 sq ft of state of the art manufacturing facility.

[2]

We have multiple automated and semi-automatic capabilities to fill oils, liquids, creams, gels,
scrubs, salts, and powders in bottles, jars and more.

[3]

### Competitive Pricing

Our aim is to provide quality products at competitive pricing so as to optimise our business
partners profits.

[4]

### Compounding

Our Manufacturing facility of wet process and of dry process mixing. Our tanks are geared higher to
output highly viscous products.

### Innovation & Competitive Pricing

Sustainable practices and clean ingredients are at the core of our entire organization.

Deliver on commitments and adhere to our word.

Commitment to sourcing using responsible methods.

[6]

### Speed

Our speed to market is unmatched in personal care.

## Why choose Bio Atoms as your business partner ?

Welcome to Bio Atoms, where a legacy of over **35+ years in pharmaceutical manufacturing** and **12+
years in cosmetic manufacturing** converges with a commitment to quality, reliability, and
innovation. As your trusted business partner, we pride ourselves on delivering products that not
only meet but exceed industry standards. Our extensive experience, coupled with rigorous quality
control processes and cutting-edge technology, ensures that Bio Atoms remains synonymous with
excellence. We understand the importance of reliability in your operations, and our track record of
on-time deliveries is a testament to our steadfast commitment.

.

## Our Cosmetic Manufacturing Products Process

Our cosmetic manufacturing products process includes several phases, including the conception of a
new product idea (Understanding Requirements), formulation, manufacturing, and packaging. In the
formulation phase, the scientists develop the top-quality ingredients to be used in the final
product. During manufacturing, they carefully follow procedures to ensure that the product is
consistent and meets the desired specifications. Packaging also plays an essential role in the final
product, as it must be functional, aesthetically pleasing, and brand appropriate.

.

At BioAtoms, we understand that success in the cosmetic industry is not just about creating
attractive products but also about building lasting relationships with our business partners. We
believe in empowering our partners to launch their quality brands, and we are dedicated to providing
the support and guidance needed to make their private label products a success.

## Few More Facts About Bio Atoms

[1]

### Physical Plant

We manufacture in over 23,000 sq ft of state of the art manufacturing facility.

[2]

### Filling

We have multiple automated and semi-automatic capabilities to fill oils, liquids, creams, gels,
scrubs, salts, and powders in bottles, jars and more.

[3]

### Competitive Pricing

Our aim is to provide quality products at competitive pricing so as to optimise our business
partners profits.

[4]

### Compounding

Our Manufacturing facility of wet process and of dry process mixing. Our tanks are geared higher to
output highly viscous products.

# About Us

**[Biocruz Pharmaceuticals Private Limited][65]** is a fastly-expanding pharma formulations
manufacturing, distributing, and exporting business company based in Panchkula (Haryana). The main
aim of our company is to manufacture and distribute the best quality pharmaceutical and healthcare
products across India at a reasonable price. There are various categories of products we offer and
they are **[general range][66]**, dermatological, **[otc range medicines][67]**, herbal, and so on.
Nonetheless, we always strive to expand the healthcare products facilities into underprivileged
regions through the appointment of new distributors. To fulfill this task, we appoint new
distributors / single distributors / C&F partners and give them a chance to grow forward in the
pharma field with us.

In addition, our company is now positioned to break into several new international markets and also
our global aim is to innovate to succeed. Rather the model of our company is established in this way
so that every single member of our company can easily grow their career. At **Biocruz
Pharmaceuticals Private Limited**, our global mission is to innovate for success in the healthcare
industry. We pride ourselves on being a family-oriented organization where every individual has the
right to a healthy life. Our team, managed by professionals with a single mission of success for
all, strives to establish a supportive environment for each member.

Biocruz Pharmaceuticals Private Limited is a reputed supplier, exporter, and service provider of
pharmaceutical products like Tablets, Capsules, Syrups, Softgels, Injections (Dry/Liquid),
Soap/Shampoos, Lotions/Creams, & much more. With rich expertise in the industry, we have garnered a
strong reputation for delivering high-quality products and exceptional services to our customers.
Biocruz Pharmaceuticals is not limited by borders. We serve clients around the world, exporting our
products to various countries. Our efficient logistics and robust distribution network enable us to
reach customers in a timely and reliable manner, ensuring that healthcare solutions are accessible
to all. Our success is propelled by innovation. We invest significantly in research and development
to introduce cutting-edge products that address unmet medical needs. Our team of scientists and
experts work tirelessly to bring new and improved formulations to the market.

[Read More...][68]

Our Vision

Our company's primary goal is to establish itself as a global leader in the healthcare industry,
offering the world the most efficient, reliable, and top-notch healthcare products.

Our Mission

At Biocruz Pharmaceuticals, our mission is clear: to provide top-quality healthcare solutions that
are accessible to all. We are committed to innovative approaches that prioritize both individual
well-being and community health.

Our Values

We truly believe that our employees are what differentiate a decent firm from a great one. The value
of imagination, originality, improvisation, and cooperation is in our hearts. Furthermore, we feel
that there are no limits to what we as a team can do and are constantly willing to explore new
products, markets, and regions.

Our Vision

We commit ourselves to total customer care by providing easily accessible quality healthcare to all.
Our mission is to enable people to do more and feel better and live longer.

[Our Values]

Our Values

Biocruz aspires to create a healthier world. Its strategic vision of “More & More with Less & Less”
has transformed into new ways of thinking, a new journey for growth, world class quality products.

## Our Culture

In our company's culture, we place a strong emphasis on innovation. We allocate significant
resources to research and development, aiming to achieve significant advancements in drug discovery
and development.

## Our Team

We maintain a group of capable and adept experts who assist us in acquiring a selection of
pharmaceutical products guaranteed for their quality. Our team members possess substantial industry
experience and make dedicated efforts to fulfill our clients' precise needs. Working harmoniously,
our professionals prioritize rigorous sourcing techniques to guarantee the cost-effectiveness of the
obtained range.

[Read More...][69]

## QUALITY ASSURANCE

From the very beginning, our organization has been dedicated to maintaining high quality standards.
Our priority is to provide our clients with the best possible products at competitive market rates.
We obtain our products from reliable and established market vendors, known for their expertise. Once
procured, each product undergoes rigorous inspection and a series of quality assessments. Our strong
focus on quality control enables us to deliver precisely crafted products with confidence in the
market. The medicines are checked on the following parameters:
* Compliance to standard Formulation
* Purity
* Safety
* Reaction with other medicines

Citron Hygiene is the leading provider of washroom hygiene services and menstrual equity programs
across the U.S. and Canada.

We partner with property managers, commercial builders, manufacturing companies, and higher

first.

Citron offers complete hygiene programs that are simple to manage and easy to scale, so your team
can focus on what matters most.

Advanced odor control and air purification to reinforce cleanliness and protect occupants.

Safe, sanitary solutions to care for infants and support parents in any facility.

[ Learn More ][65]

solutions.

[ Learn More ][66]

Stop the spread of infection, minimize absences, and make your spaces safe for everyone with
